title: Session cards are short now: 10 fit on a phone screen

owner_note.text: The Sessions page now shows one card per top-level session, about 57 px tall: title, cost (this session · with children), state, and "N child sessions · M in all". On a phone 10 cards fit on the first screen (3 before), and the top session shows 34 child sessions · 159 in all. A child session whose parent falls outside the date range keeps its own card, so it doesn't vanish; the Table view still nests children.
